description.text: The tenth set of the EX series, released in August 2005 and the largest EX set: 145 cards, 115 numbered, two secret rares and a holo subset of all 28 forms of Unown, lettered A to Z with ! and ?. It returns to Johto and the Pokémon of Gold and Silver, and its theme decks, Golden Sky and Silvery Ocean, take the Japanese set's name. It has more Pokémon-ex than any other EX set, 14, among them Lugia ex and Ho-Oh ex; Entei, Raikou and Suicune are its Pokémon Star, and it was the last set with Rocket's Pokémon.
